en: A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a wide view of densely forested hills and mountains, likely part of a mid‑elevation range. In the foreground there is an open grassy meadow with a line of conifer trees and a wooden fence to the right, next to a large leafy tree. The caption at the bottom identifies the scene as Oberbärenburg in the Osterzgebirge (Ore Mountains) at about 750 meters above sea level, specifically the Försterwiese (forester's meadow).
